title: submit(findings) payload
description: Structure only (a violation ends the episode with reward -1): wrong JSON type, a missing field, more than 30 findings, more than 10 evidence_ids (raw list length), explanation over 1000 code points. A well-formed finding with wrong content (unknown type, other currency spelling, negative amount, unknown ids) is a false positive, not a structure error. Fields beyond these are ignored. episode_id must also equal manifest.episode_id (checked by the grader).
